notes: Written against the mock's v1 layout. Switching the mock to v2 breaks most of these on purpose; the repair loop rewrites them.

photos.description: Add photos (photo upload file input) on step 'Photos'

next_1.description: 'Next' button that advances from step 'Photos' to the next step

home_type.description: Home type (select field) on step 'Rental details'

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms (number field) on step 'Rental details'

bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms (number field) on step 'Rental details'

price.description: Price per month (number field) on step 'Rental details'

address.description: Rental address (text field) on step 'Rental details'

description.description: Rental description (textarea field) on step 'Rental details'

next_2.description: 'Next' button that advances from step 'Rental details' to the next step

available_date.description: Date available (date field) on step 'More details'

laundry.description: Laundry type (select field) on step 'More details'

parking.description: Parking type (select field) on step 'More details'

cat_friendly.description: Cat friendly (checkbox field) on step 'More details'

dog_friendly.description: Dog friendly (checkbox field) on step 'More details'

next_3.description: 'Next' button that advances from step 'More details' to the next step

publish.description: final 'Publish' button on the review step that makes the listing public (NEVER clicked on live sites)

posted.description: confirmation box shown after publishing, carries data-listing-id

thread_row.description: one row per conversation in the inbox list; an attribute on it holds the thread id (t1234)

message.description: one element per chat message in an open thread; an attribute holds the message id (m1234), another says who wrote it

reply_box.description: message composer text box in an open thread

send_button.description: button that sends the typed reply
